name: Typst
title: typst.app
shortDescription: Typst is a web-based tool designed to simplify the process of composing academic and scientific papers. It offers dynamic templates that adjust to content in real-time, ensuring formatting is consistent without manual adjustments. Ideal for students, researchers, and academics, Typst allows users to focus on writing while it handles the layout. An example use case is a research team collaboratively writing a paper with complex mathematical formulas, easily managed through Typst's intuitive interface.
cons: May have a learning curve for non-technical users
